40001407.author: पदार्थः
40001407.content: गर्भे when the embryo, सप्तधा into seven pieces,  कृते having been cut, दिति: Diti, परमदु:खिता highly distressed, दुराधर्षम् unassailable, सहस्राक्षम् Indra, सानुनया affectionate, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

40001407.author: Translation
40001407.content: Deeply distressed Diti, having come to know that the embryo had been severed into seven pieces, humbly spoke to the unassailable Indra.

40001408.author: पदार्थः
40001408.content: बलसूदन O Slayer of Balasura, देवेश Devendra, मम my, अपराधात् by the fault, अयम् this,  गर्भ: embryo, सप्तधा into seven pieces, विफलीकृत: rendered useless, अत्र in this matter, तव your, अपराध: fault, नास्ति was not there.

40001408.author: Translation
40001408.content: "O Indra, Slayer of Balasura, because of my fault this embryo has been made into seven pieces and rendered useless. In this matter you have not committed any fault.

40001409.author: पदार्थः
40001409.content: गर्भविपर्यये this misfortune to embryo, मम for me, प्रियम् favour, कर्तुम् to do, इच्छामि I am desiring, इमे this, सप्त seven pieces, सप्तानां seven, मरुताम् maruts, स्थानपाला guardians of regions, भवन्तु become.

40001409.author: Translation
40001409.content: This disaster to the embryo has happened contrary to expectations. Hence, I seek a favour from you. Let these seven pieces become seven guardians of marut regions (regions of the wind).

40001410.author: पदार्थः
40001410.content: पुत्रक O Son, सप्त seven, इमे these, मम my, आत्मजा: sons, दिव्यरूपा: having celestial beauty, वातस्कन्धा: presiding deities for Vata Skandha (divisions of wind), मारुता: इति named Maruts, विख्याता: wellknown, दिवि in the sky (intermediate regions), चरन्तु let them wander.

40001410.author: Translation
40001410.content: O Son, all these seven are my sons of celestial beauty.They will become pesiding deities for Vata Skandha (divisions of wind) and let them be wellknown as maruts wandering in the universe.

40001411.author: पदार्थः
40001411.content: एक: one, ब्रह्मलोकम् in Brahma loka, चरतु may move about, तथा similarly, अपर: another, इन्द्रलोकम् Indra loka, महायशा: highly renowned, तृतीयोऽपि third one, वायुरिति known as Vayu, ख्यात: wellknown, दिवि in this universe, move about.

40001411.author: Translation
40001411.content: Among them, one will move about in Brahmaloka, another in Indraloka, and the third, well known as vayu will move around in the sky.

40001412.author: पदार्थः
40001412.content: सुरश्रेष्ठ O Best of devatas, चत्वार: four, मम आत्मजा: my  sons, तव your, शासनात् by command, देवभूता: becoming celestial beings, दिश: directions, सञ्चरिष्यन्तु may range about.

40001412.author: Translation
40001412.content: O best of devatas by your command the other four sons will remain celestial, and will range about in four directions.

40001413.author: पदार्थः
40001413.content: सहस्राक्ष: thousandeyed, बलनिषूदन: slayer of Bala, पुरन्दर: Indra, तस्या: her, तत् वचनम् those words, शृत्वा having heard, प्राञ्जलि: with folded palms, दितिम् addressing Diti, वाक्यम् these words, उवाच spoke.

40001413.author: Translation
40001413.content: The thousandeyed Indra, slayer of Bala, on hearing Diti's words, addressed her with folded palms, saying:

40001414.author: पदार्थः
40001414.content: ते to you, यथा as, उक्तम् said, एतत् सर्वम् all this, भविष्यति will take place, संशय: doubt, न not there, तव your, आत्मजा: sons, देवभूता: like celestial beings, विचरिष्यन्ति shall wander about, भद्रम् ते prosperity to you.

40001414.author: Translation
40001414.content: "Everything will, no doubt, happen the way you said. Your sons will wander about as celestial beings. Prosperity to you."

40001415.author: पदार्थः
40001415.content: राम O Rama, तौ मातापुत्रौ those mother and sons, एवम् in this way, निश्चयम् conclusion, कृत्वा having arrived, कृतार्थौ having fulfilled their desire, त्रिदिवम् towords heaven, जग्मतु: had gone, इति श्रुतम् thus heard.

40001415.author: Translation
40001415.content: "O Rama mother and sons having arrived at this conclusion in the tapovana  ascended to heaven with their desire fulfilled. This is what we have heard."

40001416.author: पदार्थः
40001416.content: काकुत्स्थ O Rama, एष: this one, पुरा formerly, महेन्द्राध्युषित: inhabited by Indra, स: that, देश: country, यत्र where, स: he, तप: in austerities, सिद्धाम् succeded, दितिम् Diti, एवम् this way, परिचचार attended on.

40001416.author: Translation
40001416.content: "O Descendant of Kakustha (Rama) this is that country which was formerly inhabited by Indra. Here Indra  attended on Diti who achieved the fruit of her austerities.

40001417.author: पदार्थः
40001417.content: नरव्याघ्र O Tiger among men, Rama, इक्ष्वाको: for Ikshvaku, अलम्बुषायाम् in Alambusa, परमधार्मिक: highly virtuous, विशाल इति named Vishala, विश्रुत: wellknown, पुत्र: son, उत्पन्न: was norn, तेन by him, इह here, स्थाने in this place, विशालेति named as Vishala, पुरी city, कृता आसीत् was built.

40001417.author: Translation
40001417.content: "O Tiger among men (Rama) this highly virtuous and wellknown son named Vishala was born to Ikshvakus in Alambusa. Where, a city named Vishala was built.

40001418.author: पदार्थः
40001418.content: नरव्याघ्र O Tiger among men, Rama, इक्ष्वाको: for Ikshvaku, अलम्बुषायाम् in Alambusa, परमधार्मिक: highly virtuous, विशाल इति named Vishala, विश्रुत: wellknown, पुत्र: son, उत्पन्न: was born, तेन by him, इह here, स्थाने in this place, विशालेति named as Vishala, पुरी city, कृता आसीत् was built.

40001418.author: Translation
40001418.content: "O Tiger among men (Rama) this highly virtuous and wellknown son named Vishala was born to Ikshvakus in Alambusa. Where, a city named Vishala was built.

40001419.author: पदार्थः
40001419.content: राम O Rama, महाबल: mighty, हेमचन्द्र: Hemachandra, विशालस्य Vishala's, सुत: son, हेमचन्द्रात् from Hemachandra, अनन्तर: his successor, सुचन्द्र इति as Suchandra, विख्यात: celebrated one.

40001419.author: Translation
40001419.content: O Rama mighty Hemachandra was Vishala's son. Hemachandra's successor was the celebrated Suchandra.

40001420.author: पदार्थः
40001420.content: राम O Rama, सुचन्द्रतनय: son of Suchandra, धूम्राश्व इति as Dhumraswa, विश्रुत: wellknown, सञ्जय: Sanjaya, धूम्राश्वतनय: son of Dhumraswa, समपद्यत was born.

40001420.author: Translation
40001420.content: O Rama son of Suchandra was Dhumraswa, wellknown Sanjaya was the son of Dhumraswa.

40001421.author: पदार्थः
40001421.content: श्रीमान् prosperous, प्रतापवान् powerful, सहदेव: Sahadeva, सञ्जयस्य Sanjaya's, सुत: son, परमधार्मिक: highly virtuous, कुशाश्व: Kusaswa, सहदेवस्य Sahadeva's, पुत्र: son.

40001421.author: Translation
40001421.content: Prosperous and powerful Sahadeva was Sanjaya's son. Highly virtuous Kusaswa was Sahadeva's son.

40001422.author: पदार्थः
40001422.content: महातेजा: highly lustrous, प्रतापवान् powerful, सोमदत्त: Somadatta, कुशाश्वस्य Kusaswa's (son), सोमदत्तस्य Somadatta's, पुत्र: son, काकुत्स्थ: Kakutstha, इति विश्रुत: is wellknown.

40001422.author: Translation
40001422.content: Brilliant and powerful Somadatta was Kusaswa's son. That Somadatta's son was Kakutstha is wellknown.

40001423.author: पदार्थः
40001423.content: सम्प्रति now, इमां पुरीम् in this city, तस्य पुत्र: son of Ikshvaku, महातेजा: heroic, अमरप्रख्य: equal to devatas, दुर्जय: invincible, सुमतिर्नाम named Sumati, आवसति is living.

40001423.author: Translation
40001423.content: Son of Ikshvakus, Sumati comparable to devatas, invincible and exceedingly energetic is still ruling this city.

40001424.author: पदार्थः
40001424.content: इक्ष्वाको: Ikshwaku's, प्रसादेन by his graciousness, वैशालिका: relating to Vishala, नृपा: kings, सर्वे all, दीर्घायुष: possessing longlife, महात्मान: exalted, वीर्यवन्त: valourous, सुधार्मिका: are virtuous.

40001424.author: Translation
40001424.content: By the grace of the Ikshvakus, all the kings of Vishala have been long lived and exalted, valiant and deeply religious.

40001425.author: पदार्थः
40001425.content: राम O Rama, अद्य today, रजनीम् night, वयम् we, इह here, सुखम् happily, वत्स्यामहे will stay on, नरश्रेष्ठ O Best among men, श्व: tomorrow, प्रभाते early morning, जनकम् Janaka, द्रष्टुम् to see, अर्हसि fit and proper.

40001425.author: Translation
40001425.content: O Rama we shall spend the right happily here. O Best among men On the tomorrow we see Janaka".

40001426.author: पदार्थः
40001426.content: महातेजा: most brilliant, महायशा: man of immense renown, नरवरश्रेष्ठ: chief of men, सुमतिस्तु king Sumati, विश्वामित्रम् Visvamitra, उपागतम् arrived, श्रुत्वा having heard, प्रत्युद्गच्छत् went forward (to receive him).

40001426.author: Translation
40001426.content: Having heard of the arrival of Viswamitra the celebrated Sumati, most brilliant chief of kings proceeded (to receive him).

40001427.author: पदार्थः
40001427.content: सोपाध्याय: with spiritual preceptors, सबान्धव: together with  his relatives, परमाम् supreme, पूजाम् honours, कृत्वा having performed, प्राञ्जलि: with folded palms, कुशलम् welfare, पृष्ट्वा having enquired, अथ thereafter, विश्वामित्रम् addressing Visvamitra, अब्रवीत् spoke.

40001427.author: Translation
40001427.content: Along with his spiritual preceptors and relatives he paid Viswamitra great respect, enquired his wellbeing and said:

40001428.author: पदार्थः
40001428.content: यस्य मे my, विषयम् country, मुनि: Muni (you), सम्प्राप्त: has visited, दर्शनम् चैव having graced all of us, धन्य: अस्मि blessed am I, अनुगृहीत: अस्मि I am ( highly )favoured, मम for me, न अस्ति धन्यतर: there is none more blessed than me.

40001428.author: Translation
40001428.content: "O Sage no one is more blessed than me since you have favoured me with your arrival in my country." इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे सप्तचत्वारिंशस्सर्ग:।। Thus ends the fortyseventh sarga of Balakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
